tools.name: attach_files
tools.description: Send the geometry as base64 bytes. Quotes need it — a job with no file waits for one. Accepts STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP, IGES, PLY, DXF, SVG, images and PDF. Up to 10 files, 50MB each. We will not fetch a URL for you; send the bytes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_job, attach_files, escalate_to_human · Private data: submit_job, attach_files, check_geometry · Public sink: submit_job, attach_files, check_geometry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_job, attach_files, escalate_to_human · Private data: submit_job, attach_files, check_geometry · Public sink: submit_job, attach_files, check_geometry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
